narr: Thunderstorms developed ahead of a slow moving cold front tracking through Central and Eastern Pennsylvania during the afternoon and evening. Numerous thunderstorm complexes moved over the same locations in Susquehanna county producing up to 4 inches of rain in a short amount of time.
ev: Roads were washed out in this area.
Rushing water damaged the exterior wall of a house on Laurel Lake Road.
